## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%) and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -10.95%) show short-term weakness against broader 1M gains in cyclicals, producing a net neutral signal.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%); Tech lagging: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%); Utilities showing weakness: XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -4.70%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US in short-term pullback: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%); China outperformance vs peers: FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +3.60%); EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.09% | 1M: +2.51%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Healthy risk-on in crypto/thematics: ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.33% | 1M: +20.87%), IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.83% | 1M: +10.34%), ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +9.52%); small caps IWM CORRECTION (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +1.32%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Precious metals strong: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%), SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +14.35%); copper muted: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.25%).

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy leadership confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +4.03%); natural gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -5.57%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND and GLD/SLV ABOVE TREND show commodity leadership. Major divergence: SPY, XLK, XLF show 1W negative vs 1M positive (SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%), XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%), Financials (XLF) 1W: -2.64% | 1M: +1.08%) — a multi-core mismatch that tempers strong conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor exposure to XLE, GLD and selective thematic/crypto ETFs (IBIT, ETHA) showing strength; reduce exposure to short-term Tech weakness (XLK, QQQ) and monitor credit (HYG/LQD) and volatility (VXX) for regime tilt.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%), XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +7.41%), GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%).  
BEARISH: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%), XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -5.05%), Financials (XLF) CORRECTION (1W: -2.64% | 1M: +1.08%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +14.35%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +4.03%).  
BEARISH: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.25%), UNG RECOVERY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -5.57%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 (complacency trigger), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with Energy and Precious Metals showing the clearest strength. Key risk is a multi-ETF divergence (SPY/XLK/XLF 1W negative vs 1M positive) that keeps conviction tempered and warrants monitoring of credit and volatility.
